        name = oe_theme_revolt.1.appease
        trigger = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_target } gold >= var:oe_theme_revolt_target.oe_theme_appease_cost } trigger_else = { always = no } }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_target }
            add_gold = { value = var:oe_theme_revolt_target.oe_theme_appease_cost multiply = -1 }
            var:oe_theme_revolt_target = { change_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty add = 20 } clamp_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty min = 0 max = 100 } }
        }
        remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_target
        ai_chance = { base = 40 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_theme_revolt.1.recall
        trigger = { international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 5 } var:oe_theme_revolt_target ?= { has_ruler = yes } }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -5 } }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_target }
            var:oe_theme_revolt_target = { save_scope_as = oe_recall_theme }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:oe_recall_theme = { var:oe_theme_loyalty < 20 } }
                random = { chance = 30 scope:oe_recall_theme = { set_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now } }
            }
            scope:oe_recall_theme.ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_recall_strategos }
            scope:oe_recall_strategos = { remove_ruler = scope:oe_recall_theme }
            if = { limit = { scope:oe_recall_strategos = { NOT = { is_ruler_of = scope:oe_recall_theme } } } scope:oe_recall_strategos = { move_country = c:BYZ reset_ruler_title = {} } }
        }
        remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_target
        ai_chance = { base = 15 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_theme_revolt.1.officials
        trigger = { var:oe_theme_revolt_target ?= { NOT = { AND = { var:oe_theme_judge ?= 1 var:oe_theme_fiscal ?= 1 } } } }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_target }
            var:oe_theme_revolt_target = { set_variable = { name = oe_theme_judge value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_fiscal value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_officials_cd years = 2 } set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty }
        }
        remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_target
        ai_chance = { base = 35 }
    }
    option = { name = oe_theme_revolt.1.ignore remove_variable = oe_theme_revolt_target ai_chance = { base = 10 } }
